about.title: Game da Redacto
about.summary: Redacto yana kama bayanan sirri (sunaye, imel, IDs, asirin a cikin lambar) kafin ku manna shi a cikin ChatGPT, Claude ko Gemini, kuma ya canza shi don masu riƙe da wuri da za ku iya mayar da shi daga baya.
about.local: Gano yana gudana gaba ɗaya akan na'urarka. Babu wani abu da kuka manna ya bar mai bincike, kuma babu telemetry.
about.fork: Redacto kyauta ne, wanda ba na kasuwanci ba na Privacy Guardrail daga DFKI. Ba shi da alaƙa da DFKI ko amincewa da shi.

search.title: Binciken yanar gizo
search.label: Kare binciken yanar gizo
search.body1Before: Bincika abin da kuka manna a cikin akwatin binciken injin bincike, kuma yana riƙe da kowane bincike har sai an bincika tambayarsa. Ana maye gurbin bayanan sirri da kuka amince da su tare da masu riƙe da wuri kamar
search.body1After: Kafin a aika binciken. Kunna wannan yana tambayar mai bincike don samun dama ga waɗannan shafukan bincike.
search.body2: Ba a rufe shi ba: binciken da aka rubuta a cikin adireshin adireshin mai bincike, wanda bai taɓa isa shafin ba, da kuma shawarwarin da injin bincike ke buƙata yayin da kuka rubuta. Kashe shawarwarin bincike a cikin saitunan injin don kariya mafi ƙarfi.
search.declined: Ba a ba da damar shiga wuraren binciken ba, don haka kariya ta kashe.
